title: applytopup
description: applytopup applies corrections to images using the field estimates produced by topup.

imain.description: Comma separated list of names of input image (to be corrected)
imain.title: Input images

datain.description: Name of text file with PE directions/times
datain.title: PE directions/times file

inindex.description: Comma separated list of indices into --datain of the input image (to be corrected)
inindex.title: Input index

method.description: Use jacobian modulation (jac) or least-squares resampling (lsr), default=lsr.
method.title: Method

datatype.description: Force output data type [char short int float double]
datatype.title: Output data type
